description: Offline demonstration dataset. Every question has a reference answer and the keyword set used to identify answer-bearing chunks.

questions.question: Within how many minutes must a Severity 1 incident be acknowledged by the on-call engineer?
questions.answer: A Severity 1 incident must be acknowledged by the on-call engineer within 5 minutes.
questions.notes: Direct lexical match - healthy RAG baseline.

questions.question: How long are backups retained, and how often is a restore drill carried out?
questions.answer: Backups are encrypted at rest and retained for 35 days, and a restore drill is performed every quarter.

questions.question: What is the full refund window for customers, and what happens after it?
questions.answer: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase; after 30 days only a proportional refund for unused service days is issued.
questions.notes: Needs two related clauses from the same section.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees receive and how much can be carried over?
questions.answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave and up to 5 days may be carried into the next year.

questions.question: After how many failed attempts must a service stop retrying a downstream call?
questions.answer: Services must not retry a failed downstream call more than 3 times; after 3 failed attempts the circuit breaker opens.
questions.notes: The words retry/attempt also appear in the observability standards; ranking matters.

questions.question: What notice period is required to cancel a subscription without a partial charge?
questions.answer: A cancellation must be submitted at least 14 days before the next billing date.

questions.question: How often are vendors that process customer data audited, and how often are the others audited?
questions.answer: Vendors processing customer data are audited every 12 months; all other vendors are audited every 24 months.
questions.notes: Two numeric facts in one sentence.

questions.question: What are the four stages of the standard interview process?
questions.answer: The standard interview process has 4 stages: recruiter screen, technical screen, panel interview and the values interview.

questions.question: When does the 95th percentile latency alert fire, and how long is its window?
questions.answer: Latency alerts fire when 95th percentile latency exceeds 300 milliseconds over a 5 minute window.

questions.question: How quickly must all access be revoked when an employee leaves?
questions.answer: When an employee leaves, all access is revoked within 24 hours of the leaving date.

questions.question: What is the first response target for the Enterprise plan and how does it compare with the Free plan?
questions.answer: The Enterprise plan targets a first response within 4 hours, while the Free plan targets 48 hours.

questions.question: During which hours may production deployments happen, and who approves an exception?
questions.answer: Production deployments are permitted only between 10:00 and 16:00 UTC on weekdays; exceptions require Release Manager approval.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length and how many previous passwords must not be reused?
questions.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not reuse any of the last 5 passwords.

questions.question: What happens to a deployment that pushes the error rate above 2 percent, and within what time?
questions.answer: Any deployment that increases the error rate above 2 percent must be rolled back within 10 minutes.

questions.question: How long are vendor accounts kept inactive before they are disabled?
questions.answer: Vendor accounts that are inactive for more than 30 days are disabled automatically.

questions.question: When must a written postmortem be completed for a severity incident?
questions.answer: A written postmortem is required for every Severity 1 and Severity 2 incident and must be completed within 14 days.

questions.question: What is the target time to hire and how long does an offer remain valid?
questions.answer: The target time from approval to accepted offer is 35 days, and offers expire after 7 calendar days.

questions.question: How long is application data retained after the last interview stage?
questions.answer: Application data is retained for 180 days after the last interview stage, after which all candidate records are deleted.

questions.question: What is the error rate threshold that triggers an alert?
questions.answer: Error rate alerts fire when the error rate exceeds 1 percent over 10 minutes.

questions.question: What is the standard payment term for vendors and what discount applies for early payment?
questions.answer: Standard payment terms are net 45 from the invoice date, with a 2 percent discount for payment within 10 days.

questions.question: What notice is required for a suspected data incident?
questions.answer: Any suspected data incident must be reported to the Security Operations team within 5 minutes of discovery.

questions.question: How long are hardware warranties valid and what do they not cover?
questions.answer: All hardware carries a 24 month warranty covering manufacturing defects; it does not cover accidental damage.

questions.question: When does a compensation review window open and close?
questions.answer: The review window opens on 1 January and closes on 31 March, with adjustments effective from the first payroll of April.

questions.question: What is the delivery time for express shipping and what does it cost?
questions.answer: Express delivery takes 2 business days and costs an additional 12 units.
